articles.title: European states agree on a shared winter energy reserve
articles.excerpt: Twelve European governments approved a shared reserve mechanism intended to reduce sudden energy shortages during peak winter demand.

articles.title: European countries launch joint energy reserve for winter
articles.excerpt: The new agreement creates common gas and electricity reserves, although member states have not yet published detailed contribution targets.

articles.title: Public agencies introduce independent audits for AI systems
articles.excerpt: Government departments will publish risk reports and commission external audits before high-impact automated systems can be deployed.

articles.title: A small team releases an open distributed database
articles.excerpt: The project focuses on predictable replication and ships with a simulator for testing network partitions on a developer laptop.

articles.title: A practical guide to structured concurrency in Python
articles.excerpt: The tutorial compares task groups with manually managed tasks and demonstrates cancellation, timeout and cleanup patterns.

articles.title: Regional delegations begin talks on a coastal ceasefire
articles.excerpt: Negotiators opened a three-day meeting focused on civilian shipping routes, humanitarian access and a monitored pause in hostilities.

articles.title: Центральный банк уточнил условия для снижения ключевой ставки
articles.excerpt: Регулятор отметил замедление инфляции, но связал дальнейшее снижение ставки с устойчивостью потребительских цен и кредитования.

articles.title: A compact model for forecasting local heat waves
articles.excerpt: Researchers describe a smaller forecasting model designed for municipalities with limited computing capacity and sparse sensor coverage.

articles.title: Liverpool complete the signing of midfielder Mateo Silva
articles.excerpt: The club confirmed that the midfielder signed a long-term contract after completing his medical at the training centre.

articles.title: Liverpool sign midfielder Mateo Silva on a long-term deal
articles.excerpt: Liverpool have announced the arrival of Mateo Silva, with the player expected to join first-team training next week.
